_about: Phrases a reply may contain. 'claim' = states a completed (or promised) action the system may not claim without the matching record or id; 'ok' = an offer, a question, a negation or a bank fact that must never be flagged. Read by both the reply guard (agent/speak.py) and the independent grader detector (evals/claims.py).
